titulo: Norfolk police arrest two men after officers injured during unrest over asylum plans
cuerpo: Homes of people believed to be asylum seekers attacked during two nights of violence in Thetford Two men have been arrested after police were injured as they intervened to protect men believed to be asylum seekers from angry mobs trying to break into their homes. The arrests followed two nights of unrest in Thetford, Norfolk, involving more than 100 people protesting against plans to house asylum seekers in former military barracks near the market town.
